question: Can status-contrastive noncollapse supervision preserve causal subgoal locality across unseen proof depths when starting from previously qualified proof-state checkpoints?

parent.parent_result: AF-07 source-ineligible width2 seeds; single seed had near-zero numerical drift despite chance semantic truth; negative results preserved
parent.original_native_cell: AF-02 SHA-256 verified TypedLoop import from experiments/lean_reasoner/train.py

parent_artifact_provenance.source_validation: Require original GitHub CI artifact ZIP hash, source revision, complete AF-06 train receipt/checkpoint roster, exact NPZ weight comparisons and AF-06 source hashes before loading. Reject nonqualifying warmup. The imported parent source and original results remain immutable.

data.oracle: Original AF-05 finite least-Horn fixed point and independent generated Lean4.19.0 closed Boolean theorems; no novel student proof certificates claimed
data.donor_matching: Same public graph and untouched leaf facts, change selected inferred Q status; exact downstream G recomputation from Horn closure
data.input_exclusion: Only graph incidence and initial fact bits enter student. Truth labels, donor outcomes and future gates are used in training supervision/scoring, never in the recurrence input.
data.model_input_splits: Fit only train, dev for gate; held-out families first accessed by evaluate after fixed checkpoint save
data.manifest: Reuse byte-for-byte original AF-05/AF-06/AF-07 corpus_manifest.json and verify against generated canonical feature hashes

architecture.cell: Original hash-verified TypedLoop from AF-02. All model and codec parameters trainable. Every native cell call encodes/decodes actual carried code.
architecture.patch: Interchange selected Q atom's actual carried code at stage boundary; unchanged Q and all rule codes remain recipient-owned. Irrelevant-Q control patches other Q; whole code donor replay equals direct donor output.

training.source: Load AF-06 qualified warmup checkpoint exactly, copy identical parameters into each continuation; do not retrain warmup in AF-08
training.randomness: Each arm receives identical case selection, donor choice and ramp permutation. Each uses two source prefixes, one clean downstream continuation, one primary patch continuation and one irrelevant-control continuation; equal native forward/backward call structure. Extra margin/KL loss arithmetic is reported as unmatched FLOPs.
training.status_arm: Clean goal CE + 0.5 pre-Q CE + 0.25 post-Q CE +0.15 per-step clean Q CE +0.75 irrelevant-patched goal CE +0.3 irrelevant-patched Q CE +0.15 per-step patch Q CE +0.20 irrelevant-control goal CE +0.05 irrelevant-control step-Q CE +0.025 source-weight anchor MSE
training.locality_arm: Status/common loss with addressed patch ramp, exact recomputed composed labels +0.25 protected-Q logit KL +0.04 protected-Q actual carried-code MSE on each downstream step
training.noncollapse_arm: Locality arm plus 0.3 label-conditioned prototype separation hinge (margin0.45) at every Q-token post-stage code and 0.15 selected-Q changed-truth code hinge (margin0.35). Exact semantic CE remains active to prevent stable degenerate codes; no labels or donor identity enter the recurrent input.
training.ramp: Same deterministic AF-07 monotone addressed-patch ramp for locality and noncollapse; status always irrelevant patch. Matched source weights, step count, sampler and decoder.
training.sampling: Uniform samples within each of train depths2 and3; exact donor from matched AF-05 roster
training.selection: Fixed final-step weights without early stopping. Save per-arm Torch checkpoint and complete named NumPy export, source hashes, parent ZIP/training manifest checksums and all train/dev logits.
training.eligibility: Original AF-06 warmup and all compared continuation models must each reach >=.90 goal and exact joint Q on train and dev. Failure makes seed inconclusive. Scientific gates are evaluated only after eligibility; every seed stays in reported data.

metrics: clean G and exact joint Q
untouched Q correctness per downstream step
untouched Q code L2 drift per step
true/false Q code-class separation by step
heldout.primary_comparator: noncollapse versus locality, each with equal addressed-patch exposure and matched native cell calls; status-only also retained
heldout.primary_required_improvement: For EACH eligible seed and BOTH deeper held-out families, noncollapse minus locality last-step untouched Q accuracy >=0.05
heldout.other_required_gates: Noncollapse untouched Q >=0.90 absolute, irrelevant-patch G retention >=0.90, clean goal accuracy >=locality-0.03, no more false-positive goal attempts than locality, in EACH depth4/depth5 family
heldout.aggregation: Any eligible failed required stratum means fail; all seeds eligible and passing means pass; otherwise inconclusive. Eligibility cannot be retrospectively revised. Held-out results never tune objectives or thresholds.
heldout.engineering: Independent scorer reconstructs every Horn target and held-out donor, recomputes accuracy from raw predictions, checks exact case rosters and saved digests and replays sampled original checkpoint/patch/step logits. Engineering success is separate from scientific claim.
heldout.nonclaim: Prototype-class margin is explicitly label-supervised during training; this is an interpretability intervention on synthetic Horn proof state, not automated theorem proving or evidence of abstract reasoning outside this gym.

failure_policy: Preserve every scientific failure and incomplete engineering run. Scientific changes require a new AF-09 registration; AF-01 through AF-07 stay unchanged.
